Name: Zora's Sebastian Portrait Mod
Author: ZoraIllustrates
Description:
These are my Sebastian portraits! I've been working on them for a long time, so I hope you all enjoy! 
This pack includes Seb's beach outfit AND Winter outfit. 
Just so you know, the Portraiture mod is required for this mod to work. 

Also, since this is my first mod, do let me know if there are any errors or bugs. I'll do my best to fix them ASAP.

[u]How to install?[/u]

1. Download Portraiture.
2. Drag and drop Portraiture into your mods folder.
3. Locate the "Portraits" folder in Portraiture.
4. Download and unzip my mod.
5. Copy and paste it into the folder. 
6. As soon as you are in-game, talk to Sebastian.
7. Press P to change the base game Portrait to this mod when the DialogBox is open.
